description: Expo/React Native app that keeps credentials in unencrypted AsyncStorage: access and refresh tokens under camelCase keys ("accessToken", "refreshToken"), a refreshed access token written through a key constant (ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY), and a "remember me" that saves the raw password. The original rule only matched keys that START with token/access_token/…, so it caught the password but none of the tokens. VC068 must fire on each write.
